title: What Nomadic Caravan Cities Is
definition: Nomadic Caravan Cities: cities of vehicles traveling fixed circuits year-round.
description:
Nomadic Caravan Cities is cities of vehicles traveling fixed circuits year-round. It sits squarely in Future Cities & Habitats, the frontier where convoy districts science becomes road transit infrastructure.

The stakes are towed blocks-scale. Societies that master caravan hulls early will shape circuit logistics practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why convoy districts programs worldwide now treat Nomadic Caravan Cities as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Nomadic Caravan Cities needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

t: Real Research Today: Nomadic Caravan Cities
title: Real Research Today: Nomadic Caravan Cities
definition: Today's documented research behind Nomadic Caravan Cities.
description:
The road to Nomadic Caravan Cities is already being paved. Saudi Arabia's NEOM project includes The Line, a 170 km linear car-free city concept under construction. UN-Habitat projects 68% of humanity will live in cities by 2050, driving urban innovation research.

The C40 Cities network coordinates 90+ megacities on climate adaptation and emissions cuts. Together these programs form the convoy districts foundation that Nomadic Caravan Cities will build on — the road transit results, the circuit logistics methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as road transit research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2030 — The first caravan hulls district opens at 50
title: 2030 — The first caravan hulls district opens at 50
definition: 2030 milestone on the Nomadic Caravan Cities roadmap.
description:
The first caravan hulls district opens at 50,000 residents, its convoy districts grid and road transit mobility running at full design load.

What must be true first: the convoy districts results have to replicate outside the lab, road transit manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and circuit logistics operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed convoy districts demonstrations, road transit cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting circuit logistics uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Nomadic Caravan Cities
definition: Estimates Nomadic Caravan Cities readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Nomadic Caravan Cities components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a caravan hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Nomadic Caravan Cities Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Nomadic Caravan Cities operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Nomadic Caravan Cities installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 87977 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where convoy districts monitoring, road transit redundancy, or circuit logistics maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Nomadic Caravan Cities Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Nomadic Caravan Cities: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Nomadic Caravan Cities — cities of vehicles traveling fixed circuits year-round.

Phase 1 — Prove (convoy districts): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (road transit): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (circuit logistics): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (towed blocks): caravan hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and steppe-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
